title: Bucyrus Inc - proposed acquisition of DBT GmbH

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the merger

body_sections.Summary: Bucyrus Inc proposed acquisition of DBT GmbH. Bucyrus supplies and services surface mining equipment. DBT supplies and services underground mining equipment.
body_sections.Market definition: This merger was considered in the context of: - the supply of surface mining equipment, - the after sales service of surface mining equipment, - the supply of underground mining equipment, and - the after sales service of underground mining equipment.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The parties have no overlap in the product markets that they service and so it appears unlikely that the acquisition will lead to a substantial lessening of competition.
